label: Extension Result
comment: One output a test expects of one semantic-action extension.

label: trait
comment: A feature of ShEx the test exercises, as a plain name (Empty, TriplePattern, Import, SemanticAction, ...), so that an implementation can tell which tests bear on what it supports.

label: approval
comment: What the community has decided about the test itself: "Approved" or "Proposed".

label: schema error
comment: How the test's schema must be rejected: "syntax", when it does not parse, or "structure", when it parses but breaks a structural constraint, such as referring to a shape it does not declare. An entry with neither a schemaError nor a status tests the schema's representations (shexj, shexr).

label: start row
comment: The 1-based row of the schema's text at which the rejection a negative test expects begins.

label: start column
comment: The 1-based column at which the expected rejection begins.

label: end row
comment: The 1-based row at which the expected rejection ends.

label: end column
comment: The 1-based column at which the expected rejection ends.

label: ShExJ
comment: The test's schema in ShExJ, the JSON representation of ShEx. A literal is its text; an IRI (written with the term shexjURL) is the document that holds it.

label: ShExR
comment: The test's schema in ShExR, the RDF representation of ShEx. A literal is its text; an IRI (written with the term shexrURL) is the document that holds it.

label: same semantics as
comment: Another test whose schema means what this one's does, however differently it is written.

label: result
comment: The results the validation must produce, for a test that says more than conformant or nonconformant. A literal is their text; an IRI (written with the term resultURL) is the document that holds them.

label: semantic actions
comment: Code for the semantic actions the test's schema names without code of their own. A literal is its text; an IRI (written with the term semActsURL) is the document that holds it.

label: shape externs
comment: A schema providing the shapes the test's schema declares EXTERNAL. A literal is its text; an IRI (written with the term shapeExternsURL) is the document that holds it.

label: extension results
comment: What the test's semantic actions must output, in the order they output it.

label: extension
comment: The semantic-action extension, by its IRI, that produces the output.

label: prints
comment: What the extension outputs.
